stimulus.inline: **Simple interest formula:** I = P × i × n where P = principal, i = interest rate per period (as a decimal), n = number of periods.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_TO_DECIMAL: Uses interest rate as percentage instead of decimal (e.g. substitutes i = 8 not 0,08)
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_INTEREST_VARIABLE_ID: Misidentifies which value is P, i, or n in a worded problem
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_INTEREST_RATE_PERIOD: Mismatches the rate period and the time period (e.g. annual rate with months without converting)
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_INTEREST_REARRANGE: Rearranges I = P × i × n incorrectly when solving for P, i, or n
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SUBTRACTION_ORDER: Subtracts in the wrong order when computing a difference
